summary_en: FY9/25 dividend raised to ¥126/share from ¥110 forecast. Q2 dividend ¥55 (unchanged), year-end ¥71 (prior forecast ¥55 plus ¥16 special dividend). Payout ratio target 50%. To be submitted to AGM in Dec 8 for approval.
title_en: Notice of dividend revision (dividend hike) for fiscal year ending September 2026
translation_en_brief: TKC announced a dividend hike for fiscal year ending September 2025 (FY9/25) on 7 August 2024. The second-quarter dividend remains ¥55 per share. The year-end dividend has been raised from the prior forecast of ¥55 to ¥71 per share, incorporating a special dividend of ¥16. The full-year dividend thus increases to ¥126 per share from the previous forecast of ¥110 per share, compared to ¥110 in the prior fiscal year (FY9/24). The company cited its dividend policy targeting a payout ratio of approximately 50% and recent earnings forecasts as the basis for the increase, positioning it as an expression of appreciation to shareholders. The year-end dividend of ¥71 per share is subject to approval at the scheduled shareholder meeting in December 2024.
